text_block_list.text:
With the new year, Sweep Tosho moved from 
the Classic Year to the Senior Year.
And—

On this day, I came to make the first 
shrine visit of the New Year with Sweep 
Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! Tie my fortune slip to the very 
top!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me♪ Fufun, this is gonna make this 
year the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, Rob Roy was 
chosen too, wasn't she? For Horse Girl of 
the Year."
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was the case, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It wouldn't be any fun otherwise, though. 
The harder she is to beat in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, the more rewarding it'll 
be!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm going to enjoy this year to 
the fullest!
choice_data_list:
And this year, I will become the ideal 
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm going to enjoy this year to 
the fullest!
choice_data_list:
And this year, I will become the ideal 
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪ Then support me right now this 
instant!
choice_data_list: Right now?! How did you even?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Piggyback, piggyback! Familiar, hurry and 
carry me back to the academy!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not moving a single step from here! 
I'll leave the rest to you, my familiar♪"

And so, I gave her a piggyback ride, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hum-de-hum♪ Come on, come on, go 
faster!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, keep it up! Pick up the 
speed even more!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, familiar! Stop wandering 
around! Walk straight!

With her feet dangling and swinging in the 
air, Sweep Tosho playfully slapped at me 
from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufu, drop it and you'll get punished♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Huh~? So the current you isn't your ideal 
familiar, then?"
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking I still have a lot of 
room for improvement...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph. And you're supposed to be my 
familiar? How pathetic."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Should I punish you, then?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeeeey! Familiar, don't you dare slack 
offfffff!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Sweep-san is chasing her Trainer 
around with a broom...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what is even going on... over 
there...!?

—A role reversal between Trainer and 
Umamusume. Chased all over the place by 
Sweep Tosho, the Trainer ended up 
completely exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ Sounds good to me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now then, familiar. Kneel before me right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am your master and queen, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You're not going to tell me you can't 
obey orders, are you?"

"Pulling one leg back, she crouches down. 
Sweep Tosho pulls out her wand with a 
mischievous grin—"

A cane was placed gently upon the right 
shoulder, and then the left.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...You're my familiar, and for today and 
today only, you're my knight.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today, okay?! Tomorrow, I'll be 
back to just being a normal familiar!"

Following Sweep Tosho, who was in much 
better spirits than usual, we returned to 
the Academy.
